emotional_tone: Gravité académique, profondeur philosophique, autorité doctorale, premium EdTech.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-serif text-slate-50
scales.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-serif text-slate-100

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8, p-12). Layout must feel like an open manuscript or high-end museum gallery. Use wide margins.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Grid Layout Technical Rules: Subgrid support for complex cards. Deep shadows, subtle golden borders for highlights.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#0A1128] font-semibold hover:bg-[#F3E5AB] transition-colors rounded-sm border border-[#D4AF37]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#D4AF37] border border-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 transition-colors rounded-sm

cards.style: Flat solid surfaces with sharp edges (max rounded-sm). Dark surfaces (bg-[#131B33]) with 1px border of border-[#1E293B] or border-[#D4AF37]/20. No heavy glassmorphism for data to keep it readable.

vitalist_calculator.style: Retro-Futurism/Control Room hybrid. Monospace typography for numbers. Gold glowing text for the 'Confiscated Life Time' result to emphasize gravity.

images.description: Abstract deep midnight blue background with subtle golden dust particles
Dark blue premium leather texture with gold accents for specific sections
Cover of the book Finances Publiques - Une Nouvelle Théorie
Professional B&W photo of Prof. Ahmed ELY Mustapha

icons.strategy: Use classic/academic metaphors: library, scale (justice), hourglass, graduation cap.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over dark backgrounds meets APCA standards. Use text shadow on hero.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='vitalist-calculate-btn').

motion.transitions: Slow, deliberate transitions (0.3s ease) to convey gravity and weight. No bouncy or playful animations.
motion.hover: Subtle glow or 1px border highlight for interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup complete French localization (all UI text must be in French).
2. Use a Dark theme exclusively. The background should be a deep night blue (#0A1128), not pure black.
3. Implement the Navigation Bar with a Crystal Glass effect (bg-[#0A1128]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10) so it works over the hero image.
4. Construct the Landing Page Hero using 'hero_background' as the background image (with bg-[#0A1128]/40 overlay to ensure text visibility). Use Cormorant Garamond for the large H1.

5. For the 'Module Analyse Vitaliste' (Vitalist Calculator), use 'Control Room' styling. Form inputs should be sharp (Shadcn Input with rounded-sm, bg-[#131B33] border-[#1E293B]), and the result (Temps de vie confisqué) should be displayed large with JetBrains Mono font and gold text (#D4AF37).
6. Build the '/auteur' page featuring the 'author_photo' alongside his biography and LinkedIn buttons colored in blue (#0A66C2) for penal consultant and green (#057642) for professor roles.
7. Include the 'book_cover' and 'vitalist_infographic' in the educational sections of the homepage.

8. Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Dropdowns for institution selection, Tables for admin dashboard, Dialogs for paywall/watermark preview). Override their default radii to be sharper (rounded-sm) and borders to be slate-800 or gold/20.
9. DO NOT USE placeholder image URLs. Only use the media URLs provided in this JSON.
10. Remember to add data-testid to every clickable element.
